final: SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_records, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_matched FROM scanconservation AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.insurstat IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, fraction_of_matched DESC LIMIT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM scanconservation AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY 1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation AS sc2 JOIN sites AS s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = sc2.zoneref) DESC LIMIT 10))
